name: All Sins Being Equal
overview: Scripture reveals that all humans have sinned and fall short of God's glory, emphasizing the universal nature of sin and its consequence of death. While all sin incurs judgment, the Bible distinguishes a unique sin—blasphemy against the Holy Ghost—as unforgivable, highlighting that not all sins are equal in their eternal outcome. Believers are warned to live in obedience to God's will, as deliberate disregard results in greater punishment, underscoring the seriousness with which God views sin. Ultimately, the gift of eternal life through Jesus Christ offers redemption beyond the wages of sin.
